articles.title: The Czech government's new culture war assault on press freedom shows the Maga spirit is still alive in Europe | Jan Bělíček
articles.summary:
The country’s wealthy elite is aligning itself with the far-right politics of the Motorists party to stifle dissent

Oto Klempíř was for many years the frontman of JAR, a popular Czech funk-rock band. He was expelled from the band last year, not over creative differences, or even because of his collaboration with the secret police in the 1980s, but after he declared his intention to stand for parliament for Motorists for Themselves, a populist, nationalist, climate-sceptic party that is closely aligned with Maga ideology.

Klempíř is now Czechia’s culture minister and a leading figure behind an intensifying set of culture wars promoted by Andrej Babiš’s ruling coalition as it seeks to tighten its grip on power. Increasingly the government is borrowing methods favoured by Viktor Orbán in Hungary and Robert Fico in Slovakia.

Jan Bělíček is a journalist and editor in chief of the Czech media outlet Alarm

articles.title: ‘Turner prize for dance’ winner Christos Papadopoulos: failure, friction and my forgotten youthquake
articles.summary:
Amid galloping global crises, the Greek choreographer has returned to his revolutionary ideals. He explains how asking the near-impossible of dancers brings a shared joy

Christos Papadopoulos is talking about how to spend £40,000. Specifically the winnings he scooped from the first ever Rose international prize for choreography in 2025 – the dance world’s equivalent of the Turner and the Booker. The Greek choreographer came out top of four finalists, picked by a judging panel including Arlene Phillips and PJ Harvey, for his piece Larsen C, a shadowy, trance-like and glacially paced crescendo of a dance named after an Antarctic ice shelf.

Forty grand is not a bad bounty. Did he blow it on designer gear and exotic holidays? He did not. A big chunk went to his dancers, “because they are very hardworking and not so well paid – that’s the Greek reality”. The rest he invested in his new production: “I had some holes to fill, you know, in the budget.” The win may not have made Papadopoulos a household name (this is contemporary dance we’re talking about), but his work is touring worldwide. We speak over video call from Shanghai, where he is performing My Fierce Ignorant Step before its UK premiere.

articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: Zelenskyy awards Melania Trump national honour for role in brokering Oleshky truce
articles.summary:
US first lady awarded for ‘significant personal contribution to humanitarian support’. What we know on day 1,716

Volodymyr Zelenskyy has awarded Melania Trump a national honour for her role in brokering a partial ceasefire that allowed the evacuation of civilians from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. “I hereby decree that the Order of Princess Olga, First Class, be awarded to Melania Trump, first lady of the United States of America,” a decree on the Ukrainian presidential website said on Wednesday. The text acknowledged her “significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine, and for active human rights and charitable work”. Melania Trump last month announced a localised truce between Ukrainian and Russian forces to allow for residents of Oleshky – on the southern front – to leave after suffering weeks of shortages of food and medicine. She said nearly 800 people ⁠were evacuated. Ukraine this week accused Russia of taking advantage of the truce to strengthen ⁠its military position there, while the Kremlin said adjusting positions during a ceasefire was “standard practice”.

Ukraine’s security services announced the dismissal of two senior officials linked to a high-level anti-corruption probe into bogus call centres. The head of the SBU, Oleksandr Poklad, “removed from their posts two senior SBU officials implicated in an investigation by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau” (Nabu), the service said on Telegram on Wednesday. The SBU – Ukraine’s internal security service – said it was “providing full support” for the probe and that Poklad expected Nabu’s investigation to be “transparent, objective and impartial”. The two agencies have long been at odds. Revelations about the scam caused Ukraine’s prosecutor general Ruslan Kravchenko to quit in September after his offices were searched. He has denied wrongdoing.

Zelenskyy made a surprise visit to Madrid to drum up fresh military support against Russia during a summit of Latin American leaders in Spain. He confirmed his arrival on Wednesday on social media, saying “our top priority is strengthening Ukraine’s air defenses, protecting our people and expanding defense cooperation and production”. “Further support steps are being prepared,” the Ukrainian president added, without providing detail.

Russian attacks triggered power and water outages for hours across the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv and surrounding regions on Wednesday while Zelenskyy said the death toll from an attack in southern Ukraine had risen to 40. Multiple Russian guided bombs slammed into a former school and nearby shelter in the village of Komyshuvakha, near the frontline in the Zaporizhzhia region, as residents waited for humanitarian aid on Monday. In addition to those killed, Zelenskyy said 30 more people could still be buried in the rubble.

A ⁠Ukrainian drone attack killed ⁠three members ⁠of ​the same family, ⁠including a child, ​in Russia’s ‌border Belgorod ‌region, officials ‌said. The region’s general headquarters said the drone ‌struck a minibus in which ​the three people, including an ⁠eight-year-old child, were ​travelling on ⁠Wednesday.

The UK apologised to Ukrainian child refugees who were told to study Russian in English schools, as it launched funding for a new GCSE in Ukrainian, reports Matthew Weaver. “So many students were pushed into having to do Russian,” UK schools minister Georgia Gould said while announcing the new qualification. “I’m really sorry that they were put in that position.”

Canada joined a coalition of countries refusing to play ⁠ice ​hockey teams from Russia due to the war in Ukraine, with Mark Carney saying Russian skaters will not be able to compete in ⁠the world junior championship next month.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně sociálních nepokojů a kybernetických útoků cílících na kritickou infrastrukturu, včetně supermarketů v několika zemích. Politická nestabilita se projevuje vládními krizemi v Belgii a masovými protesty v Německu a Francii, zatímco geopolitická napětí zůstávají vysoká kvůli válce na Ukrajině.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest and cyberattacks targeting critical infrastructure, including supermarkets across multiple countries. Political instability is evident through government crises in Belgium and mass protests in Germany and France, while geopolitical tensions remain high due to the war in Ukraine.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující bezpečnostní dohled nad kritickou infrastrukturou v reakci na vlnu kybernetických útoků a napjatou politickou situaci v členských státech.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued security oversight of critical infrastructure can be expected in response to the wave of cyberattacks and tense political situations in member states.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v Evropě zůstává vysoce napjatá kvůli probíhající válce na Ukrajině, kde se diskutuje o nasazení západních mírových sil oprávněných opětovat palbu, a brutálním ruským útokům na civilní infrastrukturu. Vnitřní stabilitu členských států navíc narušují rozsáhlé občanské nepokoje, sociální protesty a eskalující politické spory ohledně právního státu v Polsku.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in Europe remains highly tense due to the ongoing war in Ukraine, discussions over potential Western peacekeeping forces authorized to return fire, and brutal Russian attacks on civilian infrastructure. Furthermore, domestic stability in member states is being disrupted by widespread civil unrest, social protests, and escalating political disputes over the rule of law in Poland.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zostřenou bezpečnostní ostrahu kvůli hrozícím kybernetickým útokům z Ruska a Číny a napětí spojenému s americkými volbami.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened security vigilance can be expected due to looming cyber attacks from Russia and China and tensions linked to the US elections.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí zvýšenému napětí kvůli vlně kybernetických útoků na kritickou infrastrukturu napříč devíti státy a eskalaci konfliktu na Ukrajině po ničivých ruských úderech. Finanční trhy navíc vstřebávají blížící se výměnu v čele ECB a strukturální krizi evropského automobilového sektoru, zatímco politickou scénu zaměstnávají diskuse o britsko-evropském obchodu a geopolitické otřesy z Blízkého východu.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing heightened tensions due to a wave of cyber-attacks on critical infrastructure across nine states and the escalation of the conflict in Ukraine following devastating Russian strikes. Furthermore, financial markets are absorbing the impending leadership change at the ECB and the structural crisis in the European automotive sector, while the political scene deals with UK-EU trade talks and Middle Eastern geopolitical shocks.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující bezpečnostní ostražitost vůči kybernetickým hrozbám a intenzivní vyjednávání o nástupci Christine Lagardeové v čele ECB.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued security vigilance against cyber threats and intense negotiations over Christine Lagarde's successor at the ECB can be expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním a kybernetickým hrozbám, včetně útoků na francouzské krevní banky a eskalaci napětí na Blízkém východě s přímými hrozbami ze strany Iránu. Současně přetrvávají makroekonomické tlaky kvůli inflaci v Eurozóně a politická nestabilita v některých členských státech.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating security and cyber threats, including attacks on French blood banks and rising Middle Eastern tensions with direct threats from Iran. Simultaneously, macroeconomic pressures persist due to Eurozone inflation and political instability in several member states.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další vyostřování geopolitické rétoriky, zvýšenou ostražitost kritické infrastruktury před kybernetickými útoky a pozorné sledování reakce ECB na inflační data.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of geopolitical rhetoric, heightened vigilance of critical infrastructure against cyberattacks, and close monitoring of the ECB's reaction to inflation data can be expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně vnitřních sociálních nepokojů, protestů a stávok v zemích jako Francie, zatímco přetrvávající inflační tlaky udržují Evropskou centrální banku v kurzu dalšího zpřísňování měnové politiky. Na geopolitické scéně eskalují dopady amerických politických zvratů na transatlantické vztahy a ukrajinský konflikt pokračuje s vysokou intenzitou ruských útoků na civilní infrastrukturu.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of domestic social unrest, protests, and strikes in countries like France, while persistent inflation pressures keep the European Central Bank on course for further monetary policy tightening. On the geopolitical front, the spillover effects of US political shifts on transatlantic relations are escalating, and the war in Ukraine continues with intense Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující stávkovou vlnu a protesty v západní Evropě, zostřenou pozornost vůči kybernetické bezpečnosti kritické infrastruktury a napjaté vyjednávání o financování ukrajinské pomoci mimo rámec rozpočtu EU.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further waves of strikes and protests in Western Europe, heightened focus on critical infrastructure cybersecurity, and tense negotiations over financing aid to Ukraine outside the EU budget framework can be expected.
